headline: Nasdaq Tail falls below WATCH as holiday futures remain near flat despite extreme external stress
body: An independently verified delayed NQ quote at 13:07 UTC was 29,569.75 (+0.02%), while fresh shared Finviz context generated at 13:03 UTC showed delayed NQ +0.03%.
